description.value: Walk-in tent campground at the foot of Takakkaw Falls, one of Canada's highest waterfalls, in a dramatic glacial valley deep in Yoho National Park — the falls roar constantly. Access is via the Yoho Valley Road, which has steep, tight switchbacks that restrict large vehicles and are punishing on a loaded touring bike.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website (Parks Canada frontcountry camping page for Yoho National Park) confirms reservations are accepted via online and phone, and explicitly describes wildlife-safe food storage requirements (securing food in vehicle or hard-sided trailer). OSM tags the site as backcountry=yes, but the Parks Canada URL goes to a 'Frontcountry camping' page and Takakkaw Falls Campground is a vehicle-accessible frontcountry site — this is a tag error in OSM. The website content is a general page covering all four Yoho frontcountry campgrounds and does not call out Takakkaw Falls-specific amenities such as showers, potable water, hiker/biker sites, or device charging, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM tag 'backcountry=yes' is incorrect — Takakkaw Falls Campground is a vehicle-accessible frontcountry site; the Parks Canada website confirms it is listed under 'Frontcountry camping'.
OSM record has no address or phone number; the linked Parks Canada page covers all four Yoho frontcountry campgrounds rather than providing a dedicated Takakkaw Falls Campground page.
Community listed as 'Unknown / Other' — the campground is in Yoho National Park, British Columbia, near the hamlet of Field, BC.
Website content was truncated before campground-specific amenity details (showers, water, site types) could be confirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Takakkaw Falls Campground is a legitimate, active frontcountry campground in Yoho National Park operated by Parks Canada, directly accessible by bicycle via the scenic Yoho Valley Road, and of clear value to touring cyclists in the Canadian Rockies.
enrichment_extras.notes: A national park entry pass or Discovery Pass and a separate camping permit are both required to camp here. Fire permits are available if a campfire is desired. Maximum 6 people per site; maximum stay 14 nights.
